title: Villager Delights
description: Makes Villagers get hungry if farmers are not present.
body:
This mod adds realism to the Minecraft world. It allows Villagers to go hungry if a farmer is not present slowly. Once the villager is close to starvation, they will make a low groan. The mod checks every 600 ticks if loaded to check if farmers are present to "feed" the villagers. Once they are close to starvation and no farmers are present, they will die. 

I plan for more things to be added to this mod, other than hunger!

Please let me know of any bugs!
